title: Implement Predictive Asset Maintenance Using Operational Telemetry
narrative: FEDC maintains approximately 14,000 assets across the distribution network, including substations, transformers, switchgear, and underground cables. Asset maintenance is currently scheduled on fixed intervals, irrespective of actual asset condition. This results in unnecessary maintenance activity on healthy assets, while assets exhibiting early-stage degradation are not identified until failure. Unplanned outages caused by asset failure cost FEDC an average of £2.4M per year in lost network availability penalties and emergency repair costs. We propose implementing a predictive maintenance capability that uses operational telemetry — temperature, load, harmonics, and fault events — to model asset health scores and predict failure probability. Maintenance scheduling will be updated to prioritise assets based on predicted risk rather than age alone.

requirements.title: Asset health scoring
requirements.description: The system must calculate and maintain a health score for each monitored asset, updated at least daily, based on operational telemetry and historical maintenance records.

requirements.title: Predictive alert lead time
requirements.description: The system must generate predictive maintenance alerts with a minimum 14-day lead time for assets whose failure probability exceeds defined thresholds, to allow planned intervention.

requirements.title: Integration with work order management
requirements.description: Predictive maintenance alerts must automatically create draft work orders in the network operations management system, pre-populated with asset details and recommended maintenance activity.
